request: Zeig mir meine Ausgaben 2025 bei Lebensmitteln nach Unterkategorie.

plan.title: Lebensmittel nach Unterkategorie
plan.question: Ausgaben des Jahres 2025 in der Kategorie Groceries, aufgeteilt nach ihren Unterkategorien, eine Zeile je Unterkategorie, absteigend, Spalten topic und total_eur.

sql:
SELECT subcategory AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Groceries' AND subcategory IS NOT NULL
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY total_eur DESC

der Zeitraum ist das ganze Jahr 2025

the shape is bar, so the mark is barY
the columns are topic and total_eur
names on x, euros on y
no grid on the euro axis

request: Wie summieren sich meine Stromkosten ueber 2025 auf?

plan.title: Strom aufsummiert
plan.question: Ausgaben der Unterkategorie Electricity im Jahr 2025 innerhalb des Jahres aufsummiert, eine Zeile je Monat, Spalten month als 'YYYY-MM' und cumulative_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on)), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount > 0 AND subcategory = 'Electricity'
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

request: Show our groceries split into supermarket, bakery and drugstore per month, as lines.

plan.title: Grocery subcategories per month
plan.question: Spending of the category Groceries per month of 2025, split into the subcategories Supermarket, Bakery and Drugstore, one row per month and subcategory, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', topic and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS topic,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND (
        lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%rewe%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%edeka%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%lidl%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%aldi%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%kaufland%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%penny%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%netto%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%dm%'
       OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%rossmann%')
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month, topic
ORDER BY month, topic
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
three subcategories are followed over twelve months
a line carries a series, so one stroke per subcategory and a legend
the columns are month, topic and total_eur, the euro column last
the period is 2025
reasoning_code:
the shape is line and these rows carry a series, so one lineY over all of them
the columns are month, topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic names the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
months on x with monthShort, euros on y over every figure in the rows, zero included
